dramas.title: The Mafia'S Stolen Bride
dramas.description: Sabrina wakes from a crash to find her husband cheating with her best friend. To steal her $5 billion trust, he "gives" her to his Mafia uncle, Silas. She fakes amnesia and uses Silas's power to destroy them both—exposing fake pregnancy, stealing deals, sending her husband to prison. When she tries to leave, Silas corners her: "You took ten years to reach me. Now you want to run?" He waited in the shadows for a decade—and finally turns her from a bargaining chip into his bride.

dramas.title: One Night with My Billionaire CEO
dramas.description:
Isabella is a kind-hearted career woman who never knows how to say no. On the night of her engagement anniversary, she catches her fiancé betraying her. Drunk and heartbroken, she ends up spending the night with Owen, the CEO of her company, who has been deliberately set up by someone.
When Isabella discovers she’s pregnant, the two strangers enter a marriage of convenience, each seeking what they need from the other. But as their fake marriage slowly turns real, the return of an old flame and a string of misunderstandings threaten to tear them apart—and their feelings spiral completely out of control.
Five years later, Isabella returns to the city with her young son, only to cross paths with Owen once again.
This time, can they find the love they lost all those years ago?
Five years later, Isabella returns with a little boy, and comes face-to-face with the man she never truly forgot. Can they finally uncover the truth and find their way back to each other?

dramas.title: The Day of Betrayal, I Took Everything
dramas.description: Jonathan Carter, 30, is the eldest grandson of the Carter family and the former Vice President of the Group. Outwardly a charming and elegant gentleman, he is in fact selfish, cold, and a womanizer. He treats women as playthings and collectibles (evidenced by his photo wall), viewing his wife Wendy with nothing but contempt and utility. His arrogance and betrayal are the catalysts for Wendy’s revenge, ultimately leading him to become a pawn sacrificed in the family power struggle.
